segments.tha-ap119:3.3: Uppādo [uppāto (?)] nu kimatthāya, āloko vipulo ahu.
segments.tha-ap119:4.3: Pāṇabhūte [pāṇabhutaṃ (syā.), pāṇabhūnaṃ (sī. ka.)] bhayaṃ natthi, ekaggā hotha saṃvutā [sagāravā (syā.)].
segments.tha-ap119:5.1: “Aho buddho aho dhammo, aho no satthu sampadā;
segments.tha-ap119:6.3: Avasesesu kappesu, kusalaṃ caritaṃ [karitaṃ (sī. syā.), kāritaṃ (ka.)] mayā.
segments.tha-ap119:10.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā buddhasaññako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti.

lines: So aparabhāge attano pubbakammaṃ saritvā somanassajāto pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsento yadā vipassī lokaggotiādimāha.
Āyusaṅkhāramossajjīti ā samantato yunoti pāleti satteti āyu, āyussa saṅkhāro rāsibhāvo āyusaṅkhāro, taṃ āyusaṅkhāraṃ ossajji pariccaji jahāsīti attho.
Otataṃ vitthataṃ mayhanti mayhaṃ bhavanaṃ otataṃ vitthataṃ cittaṃ vicittaṃ suci suparisuddhaṃ cittaṃ anekehi sattahi ratanehi vicittaṃ sobhamānaṃ pakampittha pakārena kampitthāti attho.
